{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured blouse with a tailored fit, mid-length hemline at the hip, color #deb295, cotton blend with a subtle texture.
Relaxed straight-leg trousers, full length reaching the ankle, color #d8a98c, lightweight wool crepe.
Minimalist structured blazer, cropped length ending above the waist, color #e2ba9f, fine-gauge merino knit.
Pointed-toe ballet flats, mid-heel height for comfort and polish, color #deb295, soft leather upper.
Delicate gold bar necklace and small hoop earrings, neutral metallic tones, polished brass and lightweight metal.
This outfit embodies a polished yet approachable workwear aesthetic suitable for an autumn office day. The monochromatic earth-tone palette creates a cohesive visual flow that feels professional without being rigid or stiff. Choosing a knit blazer over a heavy wool suit adapts perfectly to cooler seasonal weather while maintaining the requested neat dress code. The relaxed trouser cut balances the structured top layers, ensuring all-day comfort during long meetings or walks between floors."}
